key_findings: Conditional CB1 deletion in primary sensory neurons caused persistent hyperalgesia and exaggerated CCI-induced neuropathic pain, with DRG CB2 rising 5.7-fold after CCI versus 1.45-fold in WT.
CB2 antagonist AM630 (not agonist AM1241) relieved neuropathic pain and reduced astrocyte activation and neuroinflammation in DRG.
